full_name: Thea Riofrancos | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2020–2021 Social Sciences Katherine Hampson Bessell Fellow Providence College
bio: Thea Riofrancos is an assistant professor of political science at Providence College and a 2020 Andrew Carnegie Fellow. Her research focuses on resource extraction, renewable energy, climate change, green technology, social movements, and the left in Latin America.
